role.title: Some workspace items are role-based
role.description: Your current role does not include every module in this workspace menu.
role.hint: If you need a hidden area for daily work, ask the workspace owner to review your role permissions.

plan.title: Some workspace items depend on your plan
plan.description: Your current subscription does not include every module available in this product.
plan.hint: Review the Subscription page if you need more modules enabled for this workspace.

mixed.title: Some workspace items are unavailable
mixed.description: Hidden modules may depend on your role permissions, your active subscription features, or both.
mixed.hint: Use the Subscription page for plan-based limits, or ask the workspace owner to review role access.
